Gently pat until absorbed to prepare your skin with lightweight hydration. | | | Vitamin C Boosting Serum | | Apply a few drops evenly across your face after the mist has absorbed. Gently pat until fully absorbed. Use morning or evening to help improve the appearance of dullness, dark spots, and uneven skin tone. | | | 345 Relief Cream | | Apply an appropriate amount evenly across your face after your serum. Gently press into the skin until absorbed to replenish moisture and support your skin barrier. Use morning and evening. | | | Melaclear Cream | | As the final moisturizing step, apply a small amount directly to areas with visible dark spots or uneven skin tone. Gently pat until absorbed. Allow the mist to dry naturally before applying additional skincare products. Use after workouts, commuting, or whenever your skin needs refreshing comfort. | | | Lash Boost Serum | | After cleansing and removing eye makeup, apply a small amount to clean, dry lashes using the curved brush. Gently sweep from root to tip and allow the serum to dry before applying mascara. Avoid direct contact with the eyes and waterline. | | |
